name: FormulaSignal Intelligence API
description:
FormulaSignal keeps a permanent, dated, evidence-backed Record of what U.S.
pre-workout products declare, what they cost per serving, and how that has
changed. This API is the controlled external gateway to it.

It returns answers, not the Record. There is no export, no product listing, no
document endpoint and no query interface. Every response separates a declared
fact from a captured commercial fact, from a deterministic calculation, from
research context, from a regulatory record, from a documented caution, from a
limitation, because collapsing those is how supplement information becomes
wrong.

FormulaSignal performs no laboratory testing and gives no medical or
suitability advice.

Start at https://formulasignal.com/developers.

**This document is generated from the capability manifest.** An operation
here exists because a capability exists, so it cannot describe a route that
is not served and cannot omit one that is.
